title: Lock Me Up (Chest Lock)
description: Adds secure container protection with chest locking, trusted player access, and admin utilities.
body:
# Lock Me Up
Lightweight and intuitive container protection for Paper servers.

LockMeUp is a modern protection plugin built for survival servers, SMPs, and communities that want reliable container security without unnecessary complexity. Players can quickly lock their storage, trust friends, and keep valuables protected with simple and familiar commands.

The plugin is designed specifically for Paper/Purpur/Spigot and focuses on performance, clean gameplay integration, and ease of use.

# Features
LockMeUp allows players to protect containers from unauthorized access while keeping the experience simple and natural. Protected containers persist through restarts and server crashes automatically using lightweight YAML storage.

Players can also trust others to access their protected containers, making it useful for team bases, factions, and cooperative survival gameplay.

Administrators are provided with moderation tools such as force unlocking protections when needed for maintenance, rule enforcement, or abandoned claims.

Supported containers include:
- Chests
- Barrels
- Furnaces
- Smokers
- Blast Furnaces
- Ender Chests

## Player Commands
| Command              | Description             |
| -------------------- | ----------------------- |
| `/lock`              | Lock a container        |
| `/unlock`            | Unlock your container   |
| `/trust <player>`    | Trust a player          |
| `/distrust <player>` | Remove a trusted player |
| `/trustlist`         | View trusted players    |

## Admin Commands
| Command            | Description                        |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------- |
| `/lmu forceunlock` | Force unlock a protected container |


## Requirements
- Paper/Purpur/Spigot 1.21+
- Java 21

NOTE: LockMeUp is currently in beta. While the plugin is already functional and stable for testing and smaller production servers, issues may still appear as development continues.

Feedback, suggestions, and bug reports are welcome.
